plan.summary: Add webhook trigger endpoint (POST /api/v1/webhooks/{tenantId}/{flowId}) and CronSchedulerService (IHostedService) to the Automation service. Enables external systems to fire webhook_trigger flows and automatic cron-based execution of schedule_trigger flows.
plan.interview_notes: Q chose: no auth (URL-only), synthetic DB sessions per webhook call, both webhook+cron in scope, no rate limit.

files_changed.change: Added ScheduleFlowInfo DTO and GetActiveScheduleFlowsAsync cross-tenant query
Added webhook endpoint POST /api/v1/webhooks/{tenantId}/{flowId}, CronSchedulerService DI registration, endpoint discovery entry, WebhookState static counter class
New IHostedService: 60s timer, Cronos cron evaluation, per-flow error isolation, synthetic sessions

verification_questions.question: Does the webhook endpoint correctly inject __webhook_payload into SessionStateV2.Variables before calling FlowEngineV2.ExecuteAsync?
Does the CronSchedulerService correctly evaluate cron expressions using Cronos and only fire flows when they are due (not double-fire on restart)?
Are synthetic sessions properly cleaned up (EndSessionAsync called) in all code paths including error/cancellation for both webhook and cron?
Does the webhook endpoint URL /api/v1/webhooks/ (plural) correctly bypass JWT middleware which only covers /api/v1/webhook/ (singular)?

non_goals: Authentication for webhook endpoint (Q chose URL-only)
Rate limiting (Q chose no rate limit)
Contract JSON update (automation-flow-v2.json is stale but not in scope)
intentional_exclusions: No new DB tables (synthetic sessions use existing chat_sessions)

user_facing_errors: Webhook flow not found or inactive (404, INV-AT-030)
Flow trigger type is not webhook_trigger (400, INV-AT-031)
Request body must be valid JSON (400, INV-GEN-003)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All catch blocks log via JsonLinesLogger (SystemError/SystemWarn). Secondary EndSessionAsync catch blocks now log via SystemWarn/StepWarn with session ID and error message. No empty catch blocks.

aha_moments.user_pain: External systems cannot trigger automation flows without going through WhatsApp/chat pipeline
aha_moments.suggestion: Webhook endpoint enables any HTTP client to fire webhook_trigger flows directly
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a third-party CRM posts to the webhook URL and the flow fires instantly without any chat dependency

aha_moments.user_pain: Scheduled tasks like daily reminders require manual intervention or external cron services
aha_moments.suggestion: CronSchedulerService evaluates cron expressions and fires flows automatically every 60 seconds
aha_moments.aha_moment: When a salon owner sets up a daily morning reminder flow and it fires at 09:00 without any manual trigger

aha_moments.user_pain: No visibility into webhook execution results - external systems fire and forget
aha_moments.suggestion: Webhook endpoint returns synchronous 200 with messages, status, and execution_path
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the external system receives the flow's output messages in the HTTP response and can react immediately

aha_moments.user_pain: Cron service could double-fire flows on restart or during slow execution
aha_moments.suggestion: In-memory last-fired tracking with Interlocked overlap prevention ensures at-most-once semantics
aha_moments.aha_moment: When the service restarts and correctly skips the already-fired window instead of re-triggering

aha_moments.user_pain: Debugging webhook failures requires checking multiple log sources
aha_moments.suggestion: Structured logging with requestId, tenantId, flowId, and error codes in every webhook/cron log entry
aha_moments.aha_moment: When support searches by requestId and sees the complete execution trail in one place

verdict.override: Q FORCE PASS — CQ5 false positives (cross-tenant by design, no-auth by Q decision) repeated 3 iterations
